items.title: $13 trillion brokerage giant adds three popular assets
items.summary: U.S. brokerage giant plans to expand its crypto platform with three more established assets.

items.title: Charles Schwab to Expand Crypto Offering for Clients. What to Know.
items.summary: When Schwab started allowing customers to hold and trade cryptocurrencies directly in May, it limited their options to the two largest assets by market capitalization: Bitcoin and Ethereum.  “With this expansion, clients will have more choices to build a digital asset allocation alongside the investing and banking experience they know and trust at Schwab,” said Joe Vietri, head of digital assets at Schwab.  Shares of Schwab were down 1.3% Thursday morning.

items.title: Can Vanguard's Altruist Acquisition Turn Up the Heat on Schwab?
items.summary: Vanguard's Altruist deal could intensify RIA custody competition for SCHW, pressuring technology investment and pricing as AI adoption accelerates.

items.title: What’s Behind Vanguard’s Deal to Buy Altruist?
items.summary: It’s the latest step in CEO Salim Ramji’s plan to move Vanguard beyond low-cost asset management and into financial advice.

items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Opens Digital Account API To Third Party Fintechs
items.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) has launched its Digital Account Opening API, now live through wealth management platform OneVest. The new API supports digital onboarding for advisors and enterprise clients that use OneVest. The rollout expands Schwab's third party fintech integration options and broadens distribution for its custody and platform services.
